regime_context: China A-shares shows a narrowing, Gold-Miners-led tape with only 36% of themes eligible under the absolute-trend gate; backtest verdict is explicitly 'did_NOT_hold_here' (gate_helps=false), so drawdown discipline has no validated edge on this market's history. Rank-IC ~0, rotation display-only, and the desk's own track record (dir_accuracy 0.318, n=44) argues for low conviction and few theses.
emerging_watch: Watch whether AI Compute & Optics (cn_ai_compute, rank 2, score 1.555) can convert its challenger position into a durable leadership handoff: currently durability_bar is only 0.46 and breadth is a weak 0.118, so the observable to watch is breadth expanding above 0.4 AND durability_bar rising above 0.7 on subsequent detector prints; if both occur while Gold Miners' durability_bar rolls over, a leadership handoff would be CONFIRMED rather than suspected.

theses.subject: Industrial Metals
theses.thesis: Industrial Metals stands out as the only eligible theme combining the highest durability_bar after Gold Miners (0.77) with a 'trend' hurst_tag, broad breadth (0.769), and non-crowded positioning (crowding_z -0.20). It is scorable via 512400.SS, so the lean is checkable. The trend-gate leg and durability leg support it as a residual trend candidate, while negative crowding leaves room. This is not a momentum-rank buy (rank 4) but a durability-and-breadth lean.
theses.dissent: The desk's own hit-rate is 31.8% directional accuracy, and the trend gate did NOT cut drawdown on A-shares history; Industrial Metals could simply be a lagging cyclical grinding sideways while Gold Miners absorb all resource-sector flow.

falsifier.text: 512400.SS closes below its 20-day average and stays there for 5 consecutive sessions before the check-by date

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal has maximum breadth (1.0) among eligible themes and a solid durability_bar (0.66), with non-crowded positioning despite crowding_z 0.90 (below the crowded flag threshold here). The hurst_tag is 'mean-revert', which is a caution, but the breadth and eligibility legs argue it is a current, broad-based leadership candidate that could mean-revert upward from a short-term dip. Scorable via 515220.SS.
theses.dissent: hurst_tag='mean-revert' means the detector itself sees Coal as prone to fading its own moves; in a mean-reverting tape (which A-shares backtest suggests), betting on Coal continuation is explicitly against the one structural signal available.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS gives back its last 10 trading days of gains and breadth drops below 0.6 before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
